intro: Farmer Theodore Furlbrow is an evicted Westfall pumpkin farmer stranded alongside his wife Verna on the road near the Jansen Stead. Driven from their home by the Defias Brotherhood, the couple is trying to repair their broken wagon and flee into Elwynn Forest.

sections.t: A Life Packed on a Wagon
p: Theodore Furlbrow once cultivated a pumpkin patch in northern Westfall, but the rising criminal tide forced him and his wife, Verna, to abandon everything they owned. Gathering whatever they could salvage, they set out toward the safety of Elwynn Forest, urging neighbors like Farmer Saldean to follow suit. Disaster struck along the road near the Jansen Stead when their wagon broke down, leaving them stranded in plain sight of bandits and wild beasts. While Verna tends to their beloved horse Old Blanchy, Theodore watches the road with growing despair, desperate to recover cherished possessions—such as the pocket watch given to him by Verna's father on their wedding day—and hoping to warn Sentinel Hill about the bandits closing in.
